lines.text: *Buzzzz*

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Com! Let's play hide and seek!

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: We have played hide and seek three times today.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Let's do it again!

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: I'll hide, and you come find me after counting for one minute.
*Tadada*

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Commencing countdown.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: ... Are you playing hide and seek again?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Seems like you're always the one who has to go looking. You don't mind?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: It is fine. If I hide, I am quickly discovered due to the sounds of my engine.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: When I am the seeker, I can find her instantly using my thermal sensors, but I intentionally delay my discovery.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I even pretend that I cannot find her on occasion.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: This makes her very satisfied.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: You've really gotten the knack of playing with children.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Thank you for spending so much time with her.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Having me as her playmate is the most efficient choice.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: The child is energetic, and the others in this bunker need to preserve their energy,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: whereas I only need to be recharged in order to operate at full capacity.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Thank you all the same.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: She's been practically beaming lately, so we're really grateful.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: We are the ones who are grateful.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: You took us in even though we are deserters.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: You gave us shelter and food.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Well, it's not like Nikkes and robots put that much of a strain on our food provisions.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Thank you all the same.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: My colleagues have become happier as well.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: This arrangement is good for everyone.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Com. Are you really a robot?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: It feels to me like you're becoming more and more human.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Com! Aren't you going to look for me? My legs are falling asleep.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I must go play.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Haha, I'll leave you to it.
After hearing Com's explanation, Raven falls silent for a while, deep in thought.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Could this be a different location?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Or a different world entirely? No, that's ridiculous.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Tell me how to get back.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I do not know.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Let me rephrase the question in a way you can understand.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Find a route to get back, then tell me what that route is.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I cannot.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Then take me to someone who can.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I do not know.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: And what about the Ark?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I heard you muttering to yourself earlier. Something about an Ark.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Sounds to me like the name of a place.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Take me there.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: What are you planning on doing at the Ark?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I'm going to get the information I need, and then head back.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Of course, if someone decides to get in my way,

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: that could complicate matters.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: What will happen if I decline?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: That's very simple.
Raven points her sword at Com.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I'll continue wandering around, looking for another solution to my problem,

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: and you'll become a broken pile of metal by the wayside. Yet another victim of an unfortunate "accident".

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Are you strong?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: That's an interesting question.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I would love to show you, but unfortunately, I can't.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I'm prone to underestimating my own strength.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I will take you.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: But not to the Ark.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I know how you can go back.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: To be precise, I know exactly where is the key to your return home can be found.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I will guide you there.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: How do you know all this?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I harvested some data while you were unconscious.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: If you defeat the Rapture there, known as Gatekeeper, then you can go back.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Rapture? Gatekeeper? I have no idea what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Rapture is the general term for hostile robots who dominate the surface of this planet.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Gatekeeper is the name of one of those Raptures.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: You must be talking about those rust buckets that attacked me when I got here.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: They won't be a problem. I was able to cut through them easily enough.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: So, is taking down this "Gatekeeper" all I have to do?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Sounds pretty easy.
Raven inches the point of her sword closer to Com.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: A little too easy. Enough to make a person suspicious.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Lying is not a capability which I possess.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Ha, all right then. Take me there.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Only on one condition.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: And what's that?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: My---

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Withdraw thy blade.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: This tableau laid out before mine eyes reeks of intimidation and threats. It is most unpleasant to behold.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Who the hell are you?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: You heard her. Withdraw your sword. We won't ask you again.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I don't know what's happening here, but violence and intimidation are never the answer.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Then we shall solve this in the way in which we are most well-versed.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Sounds fun. I'd like to give it a try.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Something here isn't right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Are you a Nikke?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: What's a Nikke?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Are you a human?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I asked if you're a human.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Me? A human?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: You tell me.
Raven vanishes, leaving a diaphanous mass of blue particles in her wake.
Then, in a flash of blue, she reappears behind Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Could a human do this?
*Clang*
Scarlet blocks Raven's sword.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A most interesting technique.
The swordfight between Raven and Scarlet intensifies, their blades clashing again and again.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: You're not bad!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Nor you.
A panoply of slash marks carve up the ground as the two blades cleave through rocks and other structures,
all the while accompanied by the ceaseless sound of metal clashing.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Scarlet!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Understood!
Scarlet quickly distances herself from Raven.
At the same time, Snow White aims her turret at Raven and unleashes a salvo of missiles.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Snow White! What are you doing...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Get ready!
*Slice*
Raven slices through each of the missiles with her sword.
*Booom*
The severed missile fragments swirl in the air and explode.
Through the fire and flame, Raven emerges.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: *Gasp*!
Rapunzel's staff fires a golden beam, and scores a direct hit on Raven.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Urgh!
Raven is tossed back and tumbles several times, but quickly gets back up.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Grr...!
Scarlet clenches and loosens her hand, which has gone numb, a few times before re-assuming her stance.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 'Tis a most bewildering sword.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: How about we try our words?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: That's probably our best option, considering it doesn't seem like we'll get anywhere fighting.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: You want to talk? Sure. We can talk.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Once you're on your knees.
Raven suddenly fixes her gaze elsewhere and freezes.
Where Com used to be,
only faint track marks remain.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Bah!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Bah!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 'Tis most peculiar. You two doth seem to be on the same wavelength.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Raptures approaching. They must have heard the explosions.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I say we fall back. There's no reason for us to fight those Raptures.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: No. We work our way through them.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: The city is right ahead of us.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: If they keep moving, they're likely to end up at the city.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Very well. Let us intercept them there.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: As for you, nameless one, we would appreciate your cooperati...
Raven is nowhere to be seen.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Did we lose her?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: She must have gone off in pursuit of that robot.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Doth we consider it wise to allow her to escape unopposed?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: As hostile as she seemed, I don't think she intended to do harm to that robot.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I think it'll be fine for the time being.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's finish off these Raptures first, then go after her.
